caption: The drawing features a single, tall, narrow glass bottle with a subtle greenish tint, centered on a plain, light beige background. The bottle has a conical shape with a wider, rounded base that tapers upwards to a narrow neck and an outward-flaring rim at the top. The outline and shading suggest the transparency and reflective qualities of glass, using light green, blue, and gray tones. To the left of the bottle, there is a vertical line with arrows at both ends, indicating height, and hand-written text reading "5½" next to the line. There are no other objects or decorative elements in the drawing.
title: Medicine Bottle
